name: concise-osint-report
description: Procedure for writing a concise, source-cited OSINT report that separates observations from inference and states confidence.

question.description: The decision or judgement the report must support.

evidence.description: User-supplied notes, links, exports or pasted source material, with dates where available.

audience.description: Intended reader, for example executive, analyst, technical or legal.

cut_off.description: Date and time after which evidence was not considered, in ISO 8601 form.

report.description: A Markdown OSINT report with bottom line, key findings, evidence, assessment, gaps and cited sources.
